'''Levgo Mar''' was a [[Cusverian]] [[Jedi]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Levgo Mar—albeit unidentified—first appeared in "[[Day (episode)|Day]]," the fourth episode of the [[Disney+]] live-action series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'',<ref name="Day">{{Acolyte|Day (episode)}}</ref> which aired on [[June 18]], [[2024]]<ref name="Release">{{DisneyPlus|subdomain=press|url=news/next-on-disney-plus-june-2024|text=Next on Disney+: June 2024}}</ref> The Jedi was portrayed by [[Marcus Levers-George]], an assistant art director for the series.<ref name="Marcus">{{Twitter|MarcusLGeorge|status/1803895494386635261|[[Marcus Levers-George|Marcus L George]]|date=2024-06-20|quote=When I got the job as an Assistant Art Director on Star Wars: The Acolyte. I was over the moon. It was always a dream to work on Star Wars, ever since I was a kid. but never did I think I would achieve my true childhood dream of actually becoming a Jedi! Still pinching myself!|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/jGrPX|archivefile=File:MarcusLeversGeorge-LevgoMar-Twitter.png}}</ref> The character was later identified in the [[2025]] [[Dorling Kindersley]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" />
